notes.title: Ver 1.1 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, this is team laeDI.
Here is the information for the Ver 1.1 patch.

[Fixed Contents]
- Some UIs not being applied to the resolution when changing the option
- Player location not being displayed on the last floor of the map booklet
- Lobby UI canvas turned off when focus is moved to another program or screen
- Issue where the faces of certain anomaly creatures were not visible
